name: P9 - internal concepts linked to English commands (file body)
base_representation: P8b R1_KEEP stable_fs (R1 from E1, 2107 bytes), frozen; concept identity = sha256 of the definition
view_body: not tested in P9 v1 (no internal concepts)
task: one English command over a file workspace -> (tool in {copy, move, delete}, selected objects, destination folder) -> act through R1
teacher: Claude (this session), training only; ATANOR interprets and acts before each feedback

evaluation.immediate_set: 30 sentences, written outside the repository by an agent without teacher context; sha256 published before the run
evaluation.delayed_set: 30 sentences, same author and instructions, opened only at the delayed run (>= 72 h after the lexicon freeze)
evaluation.truth: author's structured label (tool, selector {kind, ext}, destination); truth set = scene objects satisfying the selector; never changed after the run

measures: interpretation: tool, object set and destination all correct (components reported separately; seen vs unseen extension sentences)
action success: evaluator truth goal holds at the end and unselected objects unchanged
delayed reuse: interpretation on the delayed set with the frozen lexicon (sha checked) after >= 72 h
validity: teacher imports, model requests, sealed files outside the repository, exact sentence overlap count

decision.LINKED: CONCEPT interpretation >= 0.60 and >= NONE + 30 pp and action success >= 0.60
decision.INVALID: any teacher import or model request, or a broken seal
decision.concept_contribution: claimed only if CONCEPT - FLAT interpretation >= +10 pp
decision.delayed: REUSED if delayed interpretation >= 0.8 x immediate and lexicon sha unchanged, else NOT_REUSED

naming: 'own language ability' only for what is reproduced with teacher and Qwen off: narrow three-tool command interpretation
